title: Odoo vs ERPNext for Indian SMEs
verdict: Choose ERPNext for manufacturing or distribution when you want no licence fees and are comfortable with a leaner ecosystem. Choose Odoo when you need a wider range of modules and apps and will pay for Enterprise features and an experienced partner.
seoTitle: Odoo vs ERPNext for Indian SMEs: A Practical Comparison
seoDescription: Odoo or ERPNext for an Indian SME: licensing, GST localisation, manufacturing, customisation, hosting and implementation effort compared.
summary: Odoo and ERPNext are both open-source-based ERPs popular with Indian SMEs. Odoo has a broader app ecosystem and polished interface, with key features in its paid Enterprise edition. ERPNext is fully open source under the GPL with no per-user licence, strong manufacturing and Indian GST support, and a smaller partner ecosystem. Implementation quality matters more than the choice.

dataPoints.label: Licensing
dataPoints.value: Odoo: Community (free) and Enterprise (paid per user). ERPNext: GPL open source, no per-user licence

dataPoints.label: Indian GST
dataPoints.value: Both offer Indian localisation, including GST reports and e-invoicing support

dataPoints.label: Manufacturing
dataPoints.value: Both cover BOMs and work orders; ERPNext is often favoured by SME manufacturers

dataPoints.label: Customisation
dataPoints.value: Odoo: Python modules; ERPNext: Frappe framework with low-code customisation

dataPoints.label: Hosting
dataPoints.value: Both can be self-hosted or run on the vendor's cloud

dataPoints.label: Typical rollout
dataPoints.value: 3–9 months for a mid-sized business with a capable partner

body:
## What decides success

- A partner who has implemented your industry before.
- Clean master data: items, BOMs, customers, opening balances.
- Keeping customisation small so upgrades stay possible.

## When neither fits

If your process is unusual, a lighter core plus custom modules and integrations may serve better. See [ERP for manufacturing SMEs: build, buy or customise](/blog/erp-for-manufacturing-smes-build-buy-or-customise) and our glossary entry on [ERP](/glossary/erp).

Prices and plan features change often; check the vendors' current Indian pricing before deciding.

faqs.a: Yes, both include accounting. Many businesses still keep Tally for accounts initially and integrate.

faqs.q: Is open source free to run?
faqs.a: The software may be free, but implementation, hosting, support and upgrades are real costs.
